research_rationale: The original creates the compensation commission, its study and reporting duties, support, travel reimbursement and FACA delegation. Section 2(b) requires a report by August 1, 1987; that deadline is not proof that a report was actually submitted. Section 4(b) terminates the Commission 30 days after actual submission to the President. No occurrence date is supplied. The dossier also explicitly lacks the EO:12609 target provision, so possible changes to the deadline or termination must be examined before selecting a first end. EO:12692 section 3(b) later formally revokes this order and section 5 states September 30, 1989. Its unchecked flagged images and absence of the earlier trigger prevent a complete claim. Machine U.S. Code and eCFR hit counts do not provide the substantive snippets needed to assess those leads.
